explication: LiteX is a Python framework for composing FPGA logic and complete SoCs. A designer combines hardware cores, CPUs, interconnects, and board/target configuration; SoC integration brings these into a design that can be emitted as Verilog and used with FPGA toolchains. The repository also provides simulation, embedded BIOS/software, and host-side SoC access. The README documents the overall design flow; some subsystem details below rely on the file tree and SOURCE INDEX, so unsampled links are omitted.
